name: Zhejiang Yankon Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Yankon Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of lighting appliances in China. Its products include LED lighting products and lighting control systems, covering commercial, residential, office, outdoor, track, industrial, and educational lighting, as well as emergency lighting, plant lighting, electrical equipment, circuit breakers, distribution boxes, exhaust fans, bathroom heaters, and small household appliances.
